result.summary: The page renders largely as intended. Only a minor clipped carousel title at the right edge and a minor formatting inconsistency in the promo code were noted; no functional or critical defects are apparent.

issues.description: The horizontal "Fastest near you" carousel card title "Trattoria Piccolo" is clipped by the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has appropriate edge padding or fade/gradient affordance so clipped titles are handled consistently, or verify this matches the intended horizontal-scroll design.

issues.description: The delivery promo code is displayed in mixed case as "TALLINN3", which reads inconsistently with the all-caps styling used in the surrounding promo headline.
issues.suggestion: Present the code in a consistent format (e.g., "TALLINN3" as a distinct code chip or uppercase "TALLINN3") to make it clearer and easier to copy.
